status: New bounded retrospective development experiment; specifications written before this experiment's outcomes. All cohorts previously inspected; not independent validation.
question: Can four fixed Combine-only movement coordinates add stable rookie pressure-rate information to a separately tuned conventional baseline without large extrapolation?
cohort: Reuse exactly the preserved 74 rookies,361 accepted Combine attempts,14665 eligible rookie rushes. Whole-player rows;2023/2024 development45 players;2025 previously inspected exploratory29. No outcome-based roster exclusions.
target: Observed pressure-event fraction in supplied eligible charted rookie rush cohort. Conditional on selection, playing opportunity and context. Not the two-season pressures per defensive snap target in SCOUTING_CONFIRMATION_PROTOCOL.json.
feature_choice: Launch speed change, operational phase recovery, hoop redirection and four-bag braking span four interpretable quantities. Fixed before running this experiment; existing outcome exploration is explicitly acknowledged. Phase terms remain model-defined rather than physiologically annotated.
conventional: Reuse movement_residual.Baseline: full15/core8/motor4 sets, penalties0.1/1/10/100/1000/10000/mean, three fold whole-player class-stratified tuning; shared source Combine position and four drill-availability indicators. Includes NGS scores in full15, not purely physical. No NFL position predictor.
correction: Cross-fit conventional baseline within training to obtain response residuals. Four coordinates median-imputed, scaled and residualized against full conventional design using Ridge10 in training only; clip nuisance-residualized coordinates to[-3,3]. Fit Ridge10 without intercept to cross-fitted responses. Fixed half correction, clipped to +/-0.02 absolute pressure fraction, then final prediction clipped[0,1]. No additional hyperparameter grid.
selection: Three inner whole-player class-stratified folds compare only exact-zero versus fixed bounded correction. Apply correction only if paired inner mean squared-loss gain exceeds its player standard error; otherwise return exact same conventional predictions. This heuristic is not an unseen-player dominance guarantee.
outer: Three class-stratified four-fold development repeats seeds714/914/1114. Average losses within each player before bootstrap. Temporal2023_to_2024 and exploratory2025 refit all preprocessing/tuning using only earlier training players; no future labels enter predictions.
controls: Training-only global mean; training-only source-position mean shrunk toward training global mean with strength20; corrected conventional baseline; fixed bounded correction; inner-selected correction. Retain all results and positions, no post-hoc winner selection.
uncertainty: 4000 class-stratified paired player bootstrap draws seed717 conditional on retained predictions, no causal or new-cohort guarantee. Temporal sensitivity:20 complete training-player bootstrap refits with duplicate identities grouped, paired test-player resampling. Exactly20 for this release; more may be declared as sensitivity, not optional-stopping significance. Fixed-prediction diagnostic intervals use Bonferroni alpha.05/8 across2 temporal comparisons x4 candidate controls (global mean,role mean,fixed,selected),4000 resamples. Twenty-refit percentile intervals are coarse descriptive sensitivity only and do not establish simultaneous coverage. Development repeats not independent samples.
negative_control: 16 class-and-source-position stratified player permutations of the four player-median movement coordinates; refit entire temporal2023_to_2024 pipeline only. Preserve Combine/context fields and labels, report fraction reassigned. Descriptive null sensitivity, not a valid broad independence test or researcher-selection-adjusted p-value.
decision: No model promotion from this retrospective study. Report exact fallback frequency, worst correction, every gain/loss and refit uncertainty. A useful candidate requires positive gains across all development repeats and temporal2024 with uncertainty excluding zero, followed by genuinely uninspected later players; these are evidence gates, not permission to tune after looking.
unresolved: Rush-level pre-snap context table absent from compact continuation. No context-standardization or independent trial noise claim can be made from player totals. Preserve opportunity/context confounding and original broader-family failures. Future sealed two-season2025 confirmation remains untouched.
